# Remediate

> Training for environmental remediation crews: 40-hour HAZWOPER for remediation, site characterization, air monitoring, decontamination and gas detection, online and self-paced.

Remediate (https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40 Hr Remediation, Site Characterization, Air Monitoring, Decontamination or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER for Environmental Remediation](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-environmental-remediation): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour initial HAZWOPER for environmental remediation crews. Enroll: https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-environmental-remediation?buy=590
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Site Characterization & Hazard Assessment](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-site-characterization-and-hazard-assessment): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). A 20-minute module on how sites are evaluated before and during work. Enroll: https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-site-characterization-and-hazard-assessment?buy=586
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Air Monitoring & Direct-Reading Instruments](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-air-monitoring-and-direct-reading-instruments): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). A 20-minute module on direct-reading instruments and action levels. Enroll: https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-air-monitoring-and-direct-reading-instruments?buy=583
- [HAZWOPER Micro-Module: Decontamination Procedures](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures): $14.99 per seat, 20 Min, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). A 20-minute module on the decon line, station by station. Enroll: https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-micro-module-decontamination-procedures?buy=584
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Two-hour training on gas detection for excavations, vaults and treatment systems. Enroll: https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual 8-hour HAZWOPER refresher. Enroll: https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595

## Guides

- [Your first week on a remediation site](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/guides/first-week-on-a-remediation-site): What new field techs should expect, from the HASP briefing to the decon line.
- [Action levels explained: what the PID reading means for you](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/guides/action-levels-explained): Most remediation PPE decisions come down to a few numbers in the HASP. Here's how to read them.
- [Finding drums on a cleanup site](https://remediation.hazwoperosha.us/guides/drums-on-a-cleanup-site): Buried or abandoned drums are one of the most dangerous surprises on a remediation job.
